name: youtube-multi-source-research
description: Turn a topic, question, or URL into a timestamped, cited research brief across every relevant configured platform.

interface.shortDescription: テーマ・URLから全媒体を横断調査
interface.longDescription: Research a topic or URL across every relevant configured source, extract transcripts and claims when relevant, and return a read-only cited brief. On first use, report any local source setup still required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Universal Multi-Source Research to investigate this topic or URL across every relevant configured source, report any first-use setup needed, and return a cited brief.
